sum: AiRWA Inc., through its subsidiaries, operates artificial intelligence software that provides bridging traditional finance, blockchain networks, and AI infrastructure services in Hong Kong, the United States, Singapore, Malaysia, Taiwan, Philippines, Vietnam, Brazil, and the United Kingdom. It also offers digital marketing solution services related to performance advertising; international trading business; AI services to healthcare, industrial manufacturing, and autonomous sector; and technology licensing services. The company was formerly known as Connexa Sports Technologies Inc. and changed its name to AiRWA Inc. in October 2025. AiRWA Inc. was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in Smyrna, Delaware.
ceo: Mr. Thomas Joseph Tarala (CEO, Company Secretary & Non-Independent Director)
